newsitem.title: GHANA: No change in any prices on lifeless Ghana exchange.
newsitem.headline: No change in any prices on lifeless Ghana exchange.

text.p: Business was static on the Ghana Stock Exchange on Monday, with no change in share prices and therefore no change in the market index.
Only a handful of shares -- 16,520 -- changed hands.

"It seems everybody is hedging because therre is too much sideways trading on the Exchange of late. But, seriously, I cannot give any concrete reason for such a performance. Sentiment is just at a low," one dealer said.
The All-Share index closed at 386.17, the same as Friday.
